claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully lifted off on April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT (2235 UTC).
NASA's Artemis II mission lifted off from Launch Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the first crewed mission to the moon since 1972.
NASA's Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed mission around the moon.
NASA's Artemis II mission used the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
NASA's Artemis II mission used the Orion spacecraft.
The launch window for NASA's Artemis II mission originally opened at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
Live coverage of NASA's Artemis II mission was available through NASA on YouTube.
